what: Hovering a photo turns on a round button at the bottom right (white 15% background, 20% border) in .1s. Pressing it makes a 16px white dot appear at each item’s spot, 75ms apart, bouncing .75→1× over .5s with the curve (.2,-.25,0,1.6), and each rings a ping that expands 2× every 1s. Hovering or focusing a dot stops its ping and lifts a 24px-high spot-name tag (purchase link cell selectable) up from 4px below in .15s ease-out. Pressing again makes the dots disappear.

options.each: Delay between dots (ms), default 75 — 0 means all at once
options.base: Photo width at which the dot position (px) was measured — if given, the position scales in proportion to the current photo width (original 672), default 0 (px as is)
options.--fx-btn-dur · --fx-tip-dur: Button and label transition length (style), default .1s · .15s
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: Object dots (children, multiple) — px or % in data-x and data-y

from.where: lookbook.html .ll-shot — original ImageExplorer: button opacity 0→group-hover 100 transition-all .1s, dot set-scaleFade + scaleFade .5s ease-bounce delay 75·i ms, after animate-ping, name tag bottom-6 translate-y-1→0 opacity .15s ease-out, coordinates are px on the 672px photo.

note: The original hides buttons and dots entirely below 640px (phone) — the part keeps buttons always visible on touch devices. To hide them, use the consuming side’s css
